amount.description: What it moved on the receivables or payables account, in its currency, as owed: positive when the customer owes more (an invoice) or the company owes the supplier more (a bill), negative for what settles or credits it. Absent for a draft.

number.description: Its number, once it has one.

status.description: Its status, such as draft, posted or reversed.

type.description: The document's type, such as invoice, customer_receipt, bill or bill_payment.
